changelog: Report: the PICRUSt2 caution note sits before the pathway heatmap, so it no longer lands alone on a page after it. report_builder.py only.

previous.changelog: Report: PICRUSt2 heatmap colour is scaled within each pathway (every pathway sits at about 0.5–2%, so one shared scale was uniformly dark); sample column headers drop a prefix all samples share and stay distinct ("Bacteria_Pre-R1" and "Bacteria_Pre-R2" both showed as "BACTERIA_PR…") — also in the top-ASV and species tables. report_builder.py only: /report reloads it, no backend restart.

Reports (PDF and Word) gain a PICRUSt2 section whenever the job has PICRUSt2 results: Method text with the commands, a weighted-NSTI table with a reliability verdict per sample, the 25 most abundant MetaCyc pathways (percent of predicted pathway abundance per sample), a heatmap of the top 30, a caution note that these are predictions, and the PICRUSt2 references. picrust2_pipeline records the PICRUSt2 version in picrust2_summary.json. A .py change: uvicorn --reload restarts the backend, so deploy when no job is running.

PICRUSt2: function tables the installed version does not ship (COG in 2.6) are skipped with a note instead of a hsp.py KeyError, and are not reported as missing. Progress order EC → KO fixed. A .py change: uvicorn --reload restarts the backend, so deploy when no job is running.

PICRUSt2 runs to the end with the 2.6 command line: hsp.py had -i (trait) and -t (tree) swapped, metagenome_pipeline lacked -i/-o, and pathways were inferred from KO instead of EC. Outputs now follow PICRUSt2's own layout (EC_/KO_/COG_metagenome_out, pathways_out, *_descrip.tsv.gz). A .py change: uvicorn --reload restarts the backend, so deploy when no job is running.

PICRUSt2: its helper programs (hmmalign, epa-ng, gappa) are found — the picrust2 env's bin/ is put on PATH for each PICRUSt2 step; place_seqs failed with "No such file or directory: 'hmmalign'". A .py change: uvicorn --reload restarts the backend, so deploy when no job is running.
